reasons.C: The frozen lake: ice pools across the map, a ring of runestones with ice-blue glints, and a cold glow under the ice; the most complete idea of the area.
reasons.B: The barrow field: barrow mounds across the snow and drifting snow motes that read as snow from the camera.

fixes.C: The under-ice glow is a thin line; widen it into a glow under each pool.
fixes.B: Barrows read as plain boxes; give them the runestones C made.

notes: A, the pine wood, has good rimed pines but reads as the field in snow.
